title: What If You Sat in the Quietest Room on Earth?

scenes.text: What if you sat in the quietest room on Earth? The silence is the scary part.
It's a chamber in Minnesota with background noise of minus 9.4 decibels. That's below the threshold of human hearing.
With nothing else to hear, you start hearing yourself: your heartbeat, your lungs, even your stomach gurgling.
Without echoes to help your brain, you lose your sense of balance, and may struggle to stand.
The longest anyone has lasted there is about 45 minutes. Staff advise sitting down after half an hour.
Silence isn't peaceful. Take away the world, and your own body becomes the loudest thing in the room.
